subject: general
question: The difference between the areas of two concentric circles is 264 cm². What is the difference between the square of their radius ? (use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in area of concentric circles = π × (R² − r²)

Given Difference = 264 cm²

(R² − r²) = Area ÷ π

(R² − r²) = 264 ÷ (22/7) = 264 × 7 / 22 = 12 × 7 = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area difference = 264 cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula:**

Area of circle = πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18423ecd31da5ef705d2a17103d7e96bf8e7736beeab71b51d806ad6af74343.png] 

Let the radii of the outer and inner circles be R and r respectively.

⇒ Area of outer circle = πR²

⇒ Area of inner circle = πr²

⇒ Difference = πR² − πr² = 264

⇒ π(R² − r²) = 264

⇒ (22/7) × (R² − r²) = 264

⇒ (R² − r²) = 264 × (7/22)

⇒ (R² − r²) = 12 × 7

⇒ (R² − r²) = 84 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 84 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Annulus

The region bounded by two concentric circles is called an annulus, and its area is π(R² − r²).

Concentric Circles

Circles that share the same center point but have different radii are known as concentric circles.

Width of the Ring

The width or thickness of the circular path between two concentric circles is given by (R − r).</p
